fusions.name: Second Helpings
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Everyone Eats
fusions.desc: You tear into every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 28 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Bone Gleaning
fusions.desc: Feeds on every body within 8 tiles, up to 5. Each one gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Fed and Fierce
fusions.desc: When you are healed, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
